name: emergency-route-system
description: Unified dev runner for Emergency Route System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start" "python -m http.server 8000 --directory frontend"
scripts.dev:cpp: concurrently -n CPP_BACKEND,FRONTEND -c yellow,cyan "npm run build:cpp:backend && npm run run:cpp:backend" "python -m http.server 8000 --directory frontend"
